data.name: Adis
data.gender_notes: Adis is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Adis means 'man' or 'lord'. This name has strong biblical roots, as it is found in various translations of the Bible, such as 'Adonis', the name of the ancient Greek god of beauty, fertility, and love, who was believed to be reincarnated in a new form every year. In Christian tradition, Adis is sometimes used as a name for boys, symbolizing the lordship of God over our lives and the strength and courage that comes from being a follower of Christ.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adis total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
